blind.description: A stylized section of a freestanding spiral staircase constructed from dressed stone blocks. It consists of a central cylindrical column with wedge-shaped stone treads radiating outward in a helix, culminating in an elongated rectangular top step/landing. The surface is textured in weathered, olive-tan/yellowish-grey stone with painted seams and beveled edges. The geometry is solid and cleanly connected with no floating artifacts, holes, or separate base plinths.
blind.from_above: A circular fan pattern of radial wedge-shaped stone steps orbiting a round central pillar cap, with an extended rectangular landing step protruding at the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.2 to 1.3 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 feet tall) and about 4 to 5 feet in diameter.
